gold_row.question: Ist der Temperaturverlauf von Sensor 8.0 konstant?
gold_row.gold_answer: Der Trend der Temperatur von Sensor 8.0 ist: steigend.
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: $mote_id})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.temperature IS NOT NULL
RETURN m.time AS time, m.temperature AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
